_comment: Firefox update manifest for the self-distributed build. Published to GitHub Pages by .github/workflows/pages.yml and pointed at by browser_specific_settings.gecko.update_url in build/gen-firefox.js. Add one entry per signed release, newest last; Firefox picks the highest version it can install. update_link must be the signed .xpi, and https. Self-distribution only: AMO rejects update_url on a listed add-on.
